signatures: main: Effect<void, never, never> — Phase 0 bootstrap effect
bootCli(argv?, projectRoot?) => void — Phase 1 process-level entry
runCli(argv, projectRoot) => Promise<void> — Phase 1 async CLI runner
error_modes: ProcessFatalError — unhandled boot failure written to stderr, exit(1)
invariants: runtime.dispose() always called in finally block
Fatal errors always formatted before writing to stderr

responsibilities: Load and merge MCP server configs (global + project)
Construct Effect runtime with all service layers
Mount Ink TUI and block until exit
Dispose runtime on clean exit and on error
prohibited: No business logic in src/main.ts — delegate to cli/run.ts
No direct console.log — use logging layer
No throw from bootCli — catch all, format, exit(1)
